notes.title: Set a Watch: Digital Edition - Mobile Release Date!
notes.notes:
[b]Set a Watch: Digital Edition[/b] lands on [b]Android[/b] & [b]iOS[/b] on [b]September 18[/b], 2025! 📲🔥 As we prepare for release, the Beta version will wrap up on [b]September 16[/b], by day’s end. 🗓️ A huge thank you to everyone who joined early, tested features, and shared feedback. Your efforts have been vital in shaping the game and getting it ready for launch. 🙌

You can [b]pre-register[/b] on [b]Google Play Store[/b] or [b]pre-order[/b] on the [b]App Store[/b] now to stay one step ahead and be ready to take your party on the road the moment the game launches! ⚔️🎲

🍎 [b][url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/set-a-watch-digital-edition/id6483861915?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=announcement&utm_campaign=mobile_release]iOS[/url][/b]
🟢🤖 [b][url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.acram.SetAWatch&utm_source=steam&utm_medium=announcement&utm_campaign=mobile_release]Android[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548831/45430fdf02909ae76939c209433c9ff8baa91fc9.png[/img]

But that’s not all: a [b]Steam[/b] release is on the horizon, and we’ll share the exact date soon. 👀

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493430/Set_a_Watch_Digital_Edition/?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=announcement&utm_campaign=mobile_release

Get ready to take your party on the road and keep the fires burning wherever you play! ✨
